title: Regions Cut By Slashes
goal: Count regions formed by slash boundaries inside a square grid.
strategy: Split each cell into top right bottom and left triangles. Join triangles across open internal space and shared neighboring cell edges. The remaining connected components are the regions.

edgeCases: A blank grid has one connected region
A single slash splits one cell into two regions
Opposite slash corners enclose a central region
